nodes.label: Observation Store
nodes.responsibility: Immutable content-addressed incoming evidence

nodes.label: Canonicalization Proposal
nodes.responsibility: Propose typed events and claims; natural-language semantic extraction remains unsolved

nodes.label: Event and Claim Ledger
nodes.responsibility: Append-only events, claims, evidence, decisions, and conflicts

nodes.label: Authority and Epistemic Policy
nodes.responsibility: Admit, reject, or dispute proposed state effects

nodes.label: Bitemporal State Projector
nodes.responsibility: Current, historical, as-known, and counterfactual replay views

nodes.label: Compression Candidate
nodes.responsibility: Create immutable representation versions with preservation/discard contracts

nodes.label: Concept and Procedure Store
nodes.responsibility: Reusable invariants, scopes, counterexamples, and reconstruction rules

nodes.label: Task Query
nodes.responsibility: Frozen query, temporal cutoffs, answer schema, and resource budget

nodes.label: Selective Component Planner
nodes.responsibility: Choose query-relevant components and dependency closure

nodes.label: Decompression
nodes.responsibility: Reconstruct lineage-bearing task state and explicit unknowns

nodes.label: Replaceable Solver
nodes.responsibility: Deterministic solver execution exists; model-result parsing is descriptive and still requires a trusted protocol/artifact verifier

nodes.label: Frozen Evaluator
nodes.responsibility: Exact-answer evaluation and immutable collaborator fingerprints are executable; independent reconstruction, provenance, capability, non-packet cost, and validation-attestation verification remain partial

nodes.label: Minimum-Sufficiency Ablator
nodes.responsibility: Exact small-set or labeled approximate ablation relative to a frozen fail-closed representation contract; causal-semantic necessity remains proposed

nodes.label: Failure Analysis
nodes.responsibility: Record and cluster failures conditional on solver/task/representation

nodes.label: Meta-Representation Profile
nodes.responsibility: Knowledge about representation strengths, failures, and costs

nodes.label: Representation Repair Gate
nodes.responsibility: Captured version-content and evaluator fingerprints, task manifests, protocol, compatibility, validation, canonical packet bytes, and cost ceiling govern candidate-only activation with rollback; bootstrap roots require external sealing

nodes.label: Representation Candidate Proposer
nodes.responsibility: Query-blind candidate discovery under a frozen grammar and budget

nodes.label: Proposal-Policy Meta-Learning
nodes.responsibility: Use prior representation experience to improve future candidate search

nodes.label: Claim and Evidence Registry
nodes.responsibility: Read-only scoped claims and syntactic evidence eligibility; no trusted artifact verifier or authenticated update authority

nodes.label: Experiment Registry
nodes.responsibility: A-J protocols, artifacts, validity, and research dependencies

edges.claim: Typed synthetic canonicalization works; autonomous semantic extraction does not
Validated proposals can be appended with evidence and decisions
Claims/effects are evaluated under deterministic policy
Admitted events deterministically project bitemporal state
A handcrafted frozen codec preserves designated state with lower visible size
Components retain source event/claim lineage
Reusable concepts/procedures may replace repeated observations/chains
Task keys/kinds determine component relevance
Selector can inspect declared component scope and dependencies
Dependency closure reconstructs a task view or explicit incompleteness
An unsealed exploratory capable-solver report makes frozen packet usability plausible; local Qwen did not meet the reported Raw threshold
The reference evaluator checks deterministic exact answers; benchmark-specific evaluators handle model runs
Lineage and supplied bytes are recorded, but a general independent reconstruction/provenance grader is not yet implemented
Frozen pass predicates support component ablation
Failures are recorded; autonomous fault localization remains unproven
Conditional failure distributions can form meta-representations
A source-backed deterministic repair proposal can be gated
Accepted repair activates a new immutable representation version
Profiles may improve representation/selector choice
Failure knowledge may guide future representation proposals
A bounded proposer can emit candidates without heldout access
Metaheldout outcomes may improve proposal machinery
An improved policy may search future representation spaces better
Evidence syntax is checked, but no trusted artifact verifier or authenticated append-only update path can authorize PROVEN or SUPPORTED upgrades
Frozen protocols and success/failure criteria govern evaluation
